author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-django-react
title: Django + React in one repo
description: A Django backend with Django REST Framework and a React + Vite frontend in the same repo, with CORS configured to develop both at once.

base.command: mkdir -p {{name}}/backend && cd {{name}}/backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q django djangorestframework django-cors-headers && .venv/bin/django-admin startproject config . && cd .. && npx -y create-vite@latest frontend --template react-ts --no-interactive

writeFiles.content:
from config.api import health  # noqa: E402

urlpatterns += [path("api/health/", health)]

verify.command: cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py check && .venv/bin/python manage.py test && cd ../frontend && npm run build

instructions:
## How to work here

- `backend/` is Django + DRF (start with `cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py runserver`) and `frontend/` is React + Vite (`cd frontend && npm run dev`).
- The API lives under `/api/`; the frontend calls it with the `VITE_API_URL` URL. CORS only allows the frontend's origin (`CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`).
- Before finishing: `manage.py test` in `backend/` and `npm run build` in `frontend/`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
